name: Jellyfin Ignore Per-Library
description: Community fork of Jellyfin Ignore with per-library globs and automatic Windows/Linux aliases that keep nested dedicated libraries scannable without moving or copying media.
overview: Per-library ignore globs with automatic nested-root isolation

versions.changelog: Automatic Windows NTFS junction / Linux symlink aliases so a parent library's ignore patterns can exclude a nested folder without pruning the dedicated library that also scans it. Fixes a fresh-install stack overflow and native image-decoder failures on deeply nested Windows media paths. Adds Linux support and a dashboard main-menu entry for the settings page.
